dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 online program, likely running on IBM z/OS or CICS Transaction Server. Uses EXEC CICS and EXEC SQL (DB2) embedded commands, DFHCOMMAREA linkage, EIB fields (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN), and SQLCA include — all characteristic of IBM mainframe CICS/DB2 development.

purpose.domain_detail: Healthcare prescription management system — inserts prescription schedule rows into a DB2 PRESCRIPTION table for a given patient, based on start/end dates and dosage frequency (1-4 times per day).
purpose.summary: HCMADB02 is a CICS online subprogram that receives a commarea containing patient ID, prescription ID, start/end dates, and frequency. It iterates over each day in the date range and inserts one or more prescription schedule records into the DB2 PRESCRIPTION table at appropriate times of day based on the frequency value (1=noon, 2=morning+evening, 3=three times, 4=four times).

notable_features: EXEC SQL (DB2) INSERT with host variables
DFHCOMMAREA with EXEC SQL INCLUDE HCCMAREA
EIB fields usage (EIBTRNID, EIBTRMID, EIBTASKN, EIBCALEN)
FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE and DATE-OF-INTEGER for date arithmetic
EVALUATE on frequency to schedule multiple daily doses
COPY HCERRSWS and COPY HCERRSPD for error handling
Commented-out date validation code with %regi fix markers
Timestamp formatting via string manipulation into DB2-TIMESTAMP
verdict.notes: Program is part of a healthcare demo/tutorial system (possibly IBM's CICS healthcare sample application 'HCMA'). Comments reference a 'DEMO' scenario and a known abend fix tagged '%regi'. No COMP-3 usage. Max line length is exactly 72, confirming strict fixed format. The INCLUDE HCCMAREA in LINKAGE SECTION is unusual but valid for DB2 copybook inclusion.
